module purpose: neorv32_uart is a bus-attached UART: on bus writes it stores a control register (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, clock prescaler, baud divisor, interrupt enables, FIFO clear commands) and pushes transmit bytes into a TX FIFO sub-unit; a transmitter serializes FIFO bytes onto uart_txd_o and a receiver samples uart_rxd_i into an RX FIFO sub-unit. It returns control, status and received data on bus reads, drives RTS flow control and clkgen_en_o, and raises RX and TX interrupt requests.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, prescaler, baud divisor, interrupt enables) written from bus data into the ctrl register on a write with addr(2) = '0'
transmit request: a bus write to the data address pushes a byte into the TX FIFO; the transmitter starts when the FIFO holds data and, under flow control, CTS permits
baud tick selection: uart_clk selected from clkgen_i by ctrl.prsc; the enable is exported on clkgen_en_o
transmission: byte popped from the TX FIFO into the shift register with a start bit, shifted out at the baud rate and driven on uart_txd_o
reception: uart_rxd_i synchronized, start bit detected, bits sampled into the shift register, completed byte written into the RX FIFO
hardware flow control: CTS sampled into tx_engine.cts gates the transmit start; RTS driven from enable and RX FIFO half status when hwfc_en is set
interrupt requests irq_tx_o and irq_rx_o computed from the enable, interrupt enables and FIFO status
receive overrun flag set when a received byte is written while the RX FIFO has no free entry, cleared while disabled
control settings, FIFO status, overrun and busy returned on a read with addr(2) = '0'; received byte and FIFO sizes on a read with addr(2) = '1', which also pops the RX FIFO
TX and RX FIFOs cleared while disabled, in simulation mode, or on a one-cycle clear command
rstn_i low clears the control register, both engines, the overrun flag, the interrupt outputs and RTS, and sets the bus response to rsp_terminate_c
